readme:
Ninfer launcher – server profiles. Edit this file and restart the launcher.
  group   = dropdown section: recommended (green, tested) | usable (amber, tested)
            | bench (blue, run via ninfer_bench.exe) | untested (red)
  engine  = ninfer (default) | vllm – vllm needs the vLLM folder (with its python\ dir)
            as the server directory; the model then points to a model DIRECTORY
  vision  = none | tokens4096 | tokens8192 (ninfer only)
  mtpSpec = true/false – MTP speculation (draftTokens = drafts per step; false means MTP0)
  isBench = true → run ninfer_bench.exe instead of ninfer-serve.exe
  vLLM fields: servedModelName (name served by /v1 endpoints; defaults to the model
            path) | vllmDtype (bfloat16 | float16 | float32) | vllmQuantization (e.g.
            fp8_per_tensor) | vllmKvCacheDtype (e.g. fp8) | gpuMemoryUtilization
            (0.0–1.0, 0 = engine default) | extraArgs (extra api_server CLI args)
